name: @reconlion/mcp-parseltongue-capsules
description: MCP server for secure capsules: inspect, verify, explain, manage public contacts. Deliberately cannot seal, open, or hold a passphrase.
comment:status: No seal/open/passphrase tool exists here BY DESIGN. A passphrase passed as a tool argument, or plaintext returned from one, travels through the model context and the session transcript. Those operations live in the parseltongue-capsule CLI.
comment:license: AGPL-3.0-only as shipped: this server links the AGPL bridge for capsule inspection. @reconlion/capsule-core itself stays Apache-2.0 and standalone - the crypto is reusable, this server binary is not.
